path_steps.name: Evaluation
path_steps.evidence_needed: A named lever and a plausible chain from the technology to its financial effect.

path_steps.name: Customer zero
path_steps.evidence_needed: Measured cost per outcome against the current process, including running costs, when Tata uses the capability internally.

path_steps.name: Proof of concept
path_steps.evidence_needed: A named buyer, a budget or willingness to pay and an indicative price; for protection levers, the exposed contracts and their renewal dates.

path_steps.name: One customer
path_steps.evidence_needed: Positive contribution after fully loaded delivery costs, and a payback estimate.
